name: Pipeliners - Anthem Page Audit 2026-08-27
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-08-27

# Summary
Audit-only review of https://pipelinersusa.com/anthem/ (page 13812). Verdict: not thin (1,214 words), but the bottom third is generic OTTO filler and the page has almost no internal links.

# Key findings
- Head tags fine at the time: title, meta, canonical, unique H1, Service + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList with exactly one FAQPage.
- About 910 words of genuinely local Elementor copy (Parkside, Anthem Country Club, Daisy Mountain, caliche) and a strong 10-question FAQ.
- About 305 words in four OTTO-injected H2 sections are generic (trenchless advantage, signs you need repair, eco-friendly, emergency repair).
- Only 2 internal links on the page, one with the anchor "here!", both styled as H5 headings. Anthem was one of 20 orphaned city pages.
- 6 of 12 images had missing alt text.

# Recommendations
Wrap 5 existing phrases as service links (/trenchless-drain-pipe-repair/, /epipe-restoration/, /what-is-cipp/, /free-sewer-inspection/, /hydro-jetting/), 5 phrases as blog links (rescuing 4 orphaned posts), fix both "here!" anchors, add nearby cities carefully (Anthem is separated from the Valley), fix alts, and consider replacing the OTTO sections. Net effect: 2 links to about 14 without new copy.

# Superseded
The file says the 24/7 claim was "confirmed" on Aug 27. Scott reversed that on Oct 1: do not mention 24/7. Anthem was later rebuilt (Oct 7) and restructured (Oct 10); see [Pipeliners - Fix Log](lib:brain-pipeliners-fix-log).
